pre_factor_gate.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

primary_root_policy.name: learned_target_zero_residue16_prior
primary_root_policy.train_rows: all preregistered pre-factor-gated surfaces through transfer index 87
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 104-111 from the explicit 96-103 preregistered-policy report because it preserved 2/2 gate-selected surfaces with zero false positives and below-rho scan/direct accounting when externally trained only on <=87 surfaces

baseline_root_policies.name: learned_global_zero_root_prior
baseline_root_policies.reason: previously preregistered learned prior for 96-103; retained as the learned baseline

baseline_root_policies.name: low_root_norm
baseline_root_policies.reason: static public ordering control that was the posthoc best static policy on 96-103

promotion_condition: After generating 104-111 strict signatures and pre-factor manifests, factor only gate-selected surfaces and score learned_target_zero_residue16_prior trained only on <=87 gated surfaces. Count as positive only if preserving, false-positive-free, and below Pollard-rho under scan or direct-root accounting. Report learned_global_zero_root_prior and low_root_norm as preregistered baselines, not as replacement primary policies.
